59220-trail-tales-of-western-canada.title: Western Canada
59220-trail-tales-of-western-canada.creator: Unknown
59220-trail-tales-of-western-canada.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Old Ken was "down on his luck."  For well-nigh fifty years he had "gone the pace" in a district where certain men say glibly, "there's no God west of the Rockies." The old prospector had been, according to those who knew him best, in one of three conditions for some years.

arxiv-2107-12749.title: The glueball content of η c \eta_{c}
arxiv-2107-12749.creator: Renqiang Zhang, Wei Sun, Ying Chen, Ming Gong, Long-Cheng Gui, Zhaofeng Liu
arxiv-2107-12749.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Renqiang Zhang, Wei Sun, Ying Chen, Ming Gong, Long-Cheng Gui, Zhaofeng Liu. We carry out the first lattice QCD derivation of the mixing energy and the mixing angle of the pseudoscalar charmonium and glueball on two gauge ensembles with N f = 2 N_{f}=2 degenerate dynamical charm quarks. The mixing energy is determined to be 49 ​ ( 6 ) 49(6) MeV on the near physical charm ensemble, which seems insensitive to charm quark mass.

arxiv-2201-00259.title: Subspace Modeling for Fast and High-sensitivity X-ray Chemical Imaging
arxiv-2201-00259.creator: Jizhou Li, Bin Chen, Guibin Zan, Guannan Qian, Piero Pianetta, Yijin Liu
arxiv-2201-00259.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jizhou Li, Bin Chen, Guibin Zan, Guannan Qian, Piero Pianetta, Yijin Liu. Resolving morphological chemical phase transformations at the nanoscale is of vital importance to many scientific and industrial applications across various disciplines. The TXM-XANES imaging technique, by combining full field transmission X-ray microscopy (TXM) and X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES), has been an emerging tool which operates by acquiring a series of microscopy images with multi-energy X-rays and fitting to obtain the chemical map.

arxiv-2204-08852.title: Evolution of the γ \gamma -ray strength function in neodymium isotopes
arxiv-2204-08852.creator: M. Guttormsen, K. O. Ay, M. Ozgur, E. Algin, A. C. Larsen, F. L. Bello Garrote, H. C. Berg, L. Crespo Campo, T. Dahl-Jacobsen, F. W. Furmyr, D. Gjestvang, A. Görgen, T. W. Hagen, V. W. Ingeberg, B. V. Kheswa, I. K. B. Kullmann, M. Klintefjord, M. Markova, J. E. Midtbø, V. Modamio, W. Paulsen, L. G.
arxiv-2204-08852.description: Abstract The experimental γ \gamma -ray strength functions ( γ \gamma SFs) of 142,144-151 Nd have been studied for γ \gamma -ray energies up to the neutron separation energy using the Oslo method. The results represent a unique set of γ \gamma SFs for an isotopic chain with increasing nuclear deformation.

arxiv-2407-19781.title: Recent Developments in Real Quantifier Elimination and Cylindrical Algebraic Decomposition (Extended Abstract of Invited Talk)
arxiv-2407-19781.creator: Matthew England
arxiv-2407-19781.description: Abstract This extended abstract accompanies an invited talk at CASC 2024, which surveys recent developments in Real Quantifier Elimination (QE) and Cylindrical Algebraic Decomposition (CAD). After introducing these concepts we will first consider adaptations of CAD inspired by computational logic, in particular the algorithms which underpin modern SAT solvers.

arxiv-2412-17352.title: Efficacy of Full-Packet Encryption in Mitigating Protocol Detection for Evasive Virtual Private Networks
arxiv-2412-17352.creator: Amy I. Parker
arxiv-2412-17352.description: Abstract Full-packet encryption is a technique used by modern evasive Virtual Private Networks (VPNs) to avoid protocol-based flagging from censorship models by disguising their traffic as random noise on the network. Traditional methods for censoring full-packet-encryption based VPN protocols requires assuming a substantial amount of collateral damage, as other non-VPN network traffic that appears random will be blocked.

pmc-10652239.title: Dapagliflozin can alleviate renal fibrosis in rats with streptozotocin‑induced type 2 diabetes mellitus
pmc-10652239.creator: Song Xue, Ying-Xuan Li, Xiao-Xiao Lu, Wei Tang
pmc-10652239.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The aim of the present study was to explore the effects of Dapagliflozin on renal fibrosis in streptozotocin (STZ)-induced type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) rats, and to determine the underlying mechanism of action.

pmc-12431016.title: Time-Frequency Feature Extraction and Analysis of Inland Waterway Buoy Motion Based on Massive Monitoring Data
pmc-12431016.creator: Xin Li, Yimei Chen, Lilei Mao, Nini Zhang
pmc-12431016.description: Sensors are widely used in inland waterway buoys to monitor their position, but the collected data are often affected by noise, outliers, and irregular sampling intervals. To address these challenges, a standardized data processing framework is proposed. Outliers are identified using a hybrid approach combining interquartile range filtering and Isolation Forest algorithm.

pmc-12479070.title: Persistent Impairment of Coronary Microvascular Dysfunction After Percutaneous Coronary Intervention in an Ice Swimming Champion
pmc-12479070.creator: Gueladio Kone, Matthieu Godin, Alexandre Fuzeau, Arnaud Verdonck, Francois Raoux, Jean-Nicolas Dacher, Laetitia Neuvillers, Julien Le Moal, Quentin Landolff
pmc-12479070.description: Coronary microvascular dysfunction (CMD) is a recognized cause of persistent angina post-percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI), especially in patients without epicardial coronary stenosis. We report a case of a 58-year-old top-level sportsman and world champion ice swimmer with persistent dyspnea despite successful PCI for a mid-left anterior descending artery lesion.

pmc-12570669.title: Immature granulocyte: an early predictor of strangulated adhesive small bowel obstruction
pmc-12570669.creator: Qi Su, Qingzhi Wang, Yantian Cao
pmc-12570669.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveEarly identification of strangulation in adhesive small bowel obstruction (SBO) is crucial for emergency triage and immediate surgical intervention. This study aimed to explore the predictive value of the immature granulocyte (IG) count in assessing strangulation in adhesive SBO.MethodsThis was a retrospective analysis of patients with adhesive SBO, diagnosed surgically or by abdominal computed tomography (CT) from May 2022 to April 2025, comparing strangulated (SG) and non-strangulated (NSG) cases.

pmc-12625903.title: Examining healthcare inequality for non-communicable diseases in Malawi: a hierarchical geospatial modelling approach
pmc-12625903.creator: Yanjia Cao, Jiashuo Sun, Sali Ahmed, Pakwanja Twea, Jonathan Chiwanda Banda, David A Watkins, Yanfang Su
pmc-12625903.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectivesThe prevalence of non-communicable diseases (NCDs) is rising in low- and middle-income countries, including Malawi, yet spatial inequalities in NCD healthcare coverage remain poorly understood. In this research, we aim to: (1) develop a novel hierarchical geospatial framework to assess population coverage and accessibility of NCD services in Malawi and (2) identify underserved areas and provide evidence for targeted resource allocation.MethodsUsing 2019 Malawi Harmonized Health Facility Assessment Survey, hierarchical catchment areas were defined by facility type—primary healthcare (PHCs), district-level and central hospitals,

pmc-13064569.title: mRNA vaccines in oncology: personalized cancer immunization and neoantigen targeting
pmc-13064569.creator: Mridula Parganiha, Jaishriram Rathored, Deepika Sai Painkra
pmc-13064569.description: Precision oncology is evolving with personalized mRNA neoantigen vaccines, although long-term clinical responses vary. These mRNA-based vaccines have facilitated the development of patient-specific neoantigens. Clinical success is dependent not only on immunogenicity but also on tumor neoantigen clonality, expression, and presentation by the vaccines.

pmc-13114033.title: Distribution of Aquatic Vertebrates in the Winter Dry Season Informing Water Resource Management in a Large Floodplain Lake
pmc-13114033.creator: Hui Wang, Zijun Wu, Yanping Zhang, Jinfeng He, Guodong Ding, Chenhong Li, Haixin Zhang
pmc-13114033.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummaryFloodplain lakes are biodiversity hotspots, yet understanding how water level changes shape species communities remains limited. Using eDNA technology and sonar, we studied species in China’s largest freshwater lake without catching them. Results revealed that random chance largely determines which species live in the lake overall, but water depth acts as a local filter that sorts species by body size and ecological roles.

pmc-13421489.title: An improved analytic workflow for serum mtDNA DAMP abundance, fragmentation and heteroplasmic variants: a retrospective analysis of acute respiratory failure patients
pmc-13421489.creator: Grant T. Daly, Emily M. Hartsell, Viktor M. Pastukh, Justin T. Roberts, Adeyeye I. Haastrup, Lina D. Purcell, Madhuri S. Mulekar, D. Clark Files, Peter E. Morris, Mark N. Gillespie, Raymond J. Langley
pmc-13421489.description: Serum mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) fragments act as proinflammatory damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs), and have been linked to outcomes in critical illness. However, the prognostic value of mtDNA DAMPs remains uncertain, possibly due to confounding nuclear mitochondrial insertions (NUMTs), which obscure both quantitation and variant detection. We developed a deep sequencing and bioinformatics workflow to minimize NUMT-related artifacts.

pmc-13577290.title: Trends in HPV vaccination among adults aged 27–45 years in the United States
pmc-13577290.creator: Marcie Fisher-Borne, Nicolae Done, Amanda Eiden, Salini Mohanty, Travis Wang, Anyu Zhu, Ellen Sears, Oscar Patterson-Lomba, Yan Song, Erika L Thompson
pmc-13577290.description: Despite expanded human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination recommendations via shared clinical decision-making (SCDM) for adults aged 27–45 years (i.e., mid-adults), uptake remains low in the United States. Examining trends in HPV vaccination under SCDM across sociodemographic groups, vaccination sites, provider types, and geographical regions can offer insights into SCDM guideline implementation for HPV vaccination in eligible mid-adults.
